ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure is triangle ABC, with A at the lower left, B at the lower right, and C above. Side AB is labeled c, side AC is labeled b, and side BC is labeled a, so the standard side labels are a=BC, b=AC, c=AB. Then reason: Let angle A = x, then angle C = 3x. It is known that a = 27, c = 48. By the sine rule, a/c = sin A/sin C, so 27/48 = sin x/sin 3x, therefore sin 3x/sin x = 16/9. Using the triple-angle formula sin 3x = 3 sin x - 4 sin^3 x, obtain sin 3x/sin x = 3 - 4 sin^2 x = 16/9. Thus 4 sin^2 x = 3 - 16/9 = 11/9, so sin^2 x = 11/36. Because in the triangle B = 180° - 4x > 0, x < 45°, and cos x is positive; therefore cos x = sqrt(1 - 11/36) = 5/6. Also B = 180° - A - C = 180° - 4x, so sin B = sin(180° - 4x) = sin 4x. By the sine rule, b/a = sin B/sin A = sin 4x/sin x. Using sin 4x = 4 sin x cos x cos 2x, and cos 2x = 1 - 2 sin^2 x = 1 - 2(11/36) = 7/18. Thus b/27 = sin 4x/sin x = 4 cos x cos 2x = 4(5/6)(7/18) = 35/27. Therefore b = 35. Final answer: 35
